spec: docs/benchmarks/hm-protocol.md (frozen thresholds; LM arm amendment 2026-09-12); ADR-008 amendment 2026-09-16 (the external model arm, declared before any measurement)

window.cue: the organ's hash seeded encoder, the entity as the address (rows 13, 13b)

hm_skill_delta_admitted_band.what: the relative cost (ON over OFF perplexity minus one) of chance subsets of the admitted size, drawn from the per span records; S_adm within the band says the admitted windows cost what any subset of that size costs

veto_threshold.source: the training family alone, as the mark oracle reads it (RES-23); never the protocol's facts
veto_threshold.cue_convention: the training family is planted and read by the entity's address cue, as this arm plants and reads (rows 13, 13b); the mark oracle of the cortex's arm reads by the question's text through the checkpoint's encoder, which this arm has not
veto_threshold.rule: the window is attached to a span iff the organ returns at least one line for the span's cue and the top mark is strictly above the threshold; an empty read never attaches a window
veto_threshold.index_seed_note: the scratch index is seeded with the run's seed, as the run's own index is
veto_threshold.encoder: the organ's hash seeded encoder (the entity as the address, rows 13 and 13b)

attribution.encoder_note: the organ's number (the entity as the address)
attribution.reader_note: not observable on an external model

skill_arm.note: S' is attribution, never a condition: the verdict reads S; 1 + S'_signed = (ppl_prime / ppl_off); the admitted spans' own cost is hm_skill_delta_admitted
